metadata.title: त्रिपुरा चुनाव और बूँद बूँद पानी को तरसते लोग | Tripura Elections and issues of tribal Population
metadata.description: State Assembly Elections will be held in Tripura on 16 February. There are possibilities of a triangular contest in this election. Tribals are being talked about continuously in this election. Tipra Motha is in the election fray with the demand of a Greater Tipraland. The ruling BJP and IPFT are once again contesting the elections together. Our team visited several tribal villages in the Autonomous Tribal District Council areas and observed the situation.
